answer: A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Histories are stored in summit, checked in reef, and sonnet publishes each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 20 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 1998 identities would post 4279 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
